newsitem.title: UK: Rating agencies decline comment on Italy ratings.
newsitem.headline: Rating agencies decline comment on Italy ratings.

text.p: Moody's Investors Service and IBCA declined to comment on rumours in Italian financial markets on Friday that a rating agency was planning to downgrade Italy's ratings.
Standard & Poor's meanwhile, said Italy was not on CreditWatch and therefore a rating change was unlikely.
A spokesman for Moody's said, "Our policy on these matters is not to comment."
The spokesman said Italy has a Aa3 sovereign ceiling rating for foreign currency bonds, notes and bank deposits.
A spokeswoman for IBCA said, "We don't comment on ratings before we actually publish them."
S&P said it had received many calls inquiring about Italy's rating.
